description: This source file defines the class 'IdentityCache', a final class implementing a cache interface with a trivial implementation where the cache always returns the key itself wrapped in an Entry, and the cache operations do not modify state.

classes.name: IdentityCache
classes.description: A singleton cache that returns the key as the cache entry, implementing cache interface methods with a no-op or fixed behavior.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a completed future with the cache's getBlocking result for the provided key.

methods.name: getIfPresent
methods.description: Returns a future that behaves like 'get', checking if the key is present.

methods.name: getBlocking
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing an Entry created from the key, representing a permanent entry.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Stub method that does nothing and returns false.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as the cache cannot be represented as a map.

search-terms: cache that returns key as value
